items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I had an original tune by the name of 'Gabriel Heater'. Now, that's one of the arrangements that I do that was from the head of the Music Department at RCA Victor. He put that together.

ctx.x: Beautiful. No trouble. He did everything he possibly could for me during those years.
And when did they start talking about you as the "20th Century Gabriel"?

I was in the Savoy Ballroom doing an NBC broadcast. And, this was in the afternoon. And, the announcer at that time, he brought us on. I had this tune, "Swing Out", composed by Avery Parrish, you know. I had a kind of cadenza like that I played before the tune started swinging. So, when I started playing it slow, taking the time, the announcer happened to hit it upon himself, "The 20th Century Gabriel" coming from the Savoy Ballroom. You know, Erskine Hawkins. And from that time on, everybody, the name just stuck…
